reference_event_block_anchor: Immediately after the stage1PositionResidualGruEnabled block updates stage1PositionHeldAppliedCache and stage1PositionHeldForce, before dF=stage1PositionHeldForce and position_bs_step.
filter_input: Final stage1PositionHeldAppliedCache after C5 and residual-GRU combination/clipping.
filter_output: Replace stage1PositionHeldAppliedCache and set stage1PositionHeldForce=P.mass*filteredAction; preserve the held force until the next stage-1 event.
event_contract: Update once per stage1PositionEvent at 100 Hz; no update between events.
existing_filter_not_reused: Current runner's 3.5-Hz/Q1 filter is applied before residual-GRU addition and does not implement this contract.
